verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as batch filings, bulk renewals or mass data exports, are a fair question for an IP-office services platform. The evidence covers only individual filing procedures (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau), database search pages and a probe showing data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests. Nothing documents a bulk or batch capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
